content.text: The insurance section fully matches our preferred position — I'll submit a compliant finding.

input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 contains a full vendor insurance clause that meets or exceeds our preferred position: CGL of USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, professional E&O of USD 2M, and cyber/privacy liability of USD 5M (Vendor processes Customer Data under Sections 15 and 17), maintained throughout the term plus one year at Vendor's own expense. Section 18.2 adds certificates of insurance on request, reputable insurers, primary coverage, and confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities, preserving the Section 21 cap and Excluded Claims. The only softening is that cancellation/material-reduction notice is qualified "to the extent available from its insurer," which is a customary market qualifier not required by our position and does not warrant a redline at this severity. No insert is needed.
